'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Kevin Shannon DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet name field '''Shannon'''; dest [[Kevin Shannon]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
